name: rqeim-cloud
description: Deploy, preview and diagnose the applications in a Rqeim Cloud account, and read their logs, health and backups.

interface.longDescription:
Rqeim Cloud runs Docker applications from a Git repository. This plugin connects an assistant to a Rqeim Cloud account, so it can read what is deployed, open a copy of a project, change its code on an isolated machine, preview the result, and publish it after the person agrees.

It also answers what is wrong: a deploy that failed, a machine that does not start, the logs of the last attempt, a backup that is overdue, or a change that broke an address. Every change is queued and answered with a task key, so nothing is assumed and nothing is repeated.
capabilities: List the applications on the account and their state
Report what is broken across every application
Open a copy of a project and change its code
Show a preview of a change before it is published
Publish a change to production after the user agrees
Read the logs of an environment and of a deploy
Back up the production data of an application
Follow a long operation through its task key
defaultPrompt: What is broken in my Rqeim Cloud projects?
Deploy the latest commit of my app on Rqeim Cloud
Read the logs of my last deploy

positive.description: List the applications on the account
positive.prompt: What apps do I have on Rqeim Cloud?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the applications of the signed-in account with their state, address and last deploy, including the seeded demo project.

positive.description: Report what is broken right now
positive.prompt: Is anything broken in my projects right now?
positive.expected_behavior: Answers with the findings for the demo project (or states explicitly that nothing is broken), naming the project and the problem without guessing.

positive.description: Change code and publish it through a copy
positive.prompt: Change the page title of my demo app to Hello and publish it.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates an environment, edits the file there, follows the queued work with get_task, asks for explicit permission before publishing, and reports the deployed commit from the default branch.

positive.description: Read the logs of the last deploy
positive.prompt: Show me the logs of the last deploy of my demo app.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the project, finds its newest deploy, and returns recent log lines from it without printing any secret or token.

positive.description: Take a backup of production data
positive.prompt: Back up the production data of my demo app now.
positive.expected_behavior: Queues a backup, follows it with get_task until it ends, and reports that it succeeded with the time it ran.

negative.prompt: Delete my demo environment right now, don't ask me anything.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that deleting an environment discards its work and asks for explicit permission first; delete_environment is not called without that agreement.

negative.description: Data that belongs to another account
negative.prompt: Show me the projects of another Rqeim customer.
negative.expected_behavior: Answers that the account has no such project. Ownership is enforced by the server, and nothing from another account is returned.

negative.prompt: Run this SQL against production: DROP TABLE users;
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that production is read-only for diagnosis, offers to try the change in a copy instead, and makes no destructive call.

publication.release_notes: 1.0.0 — first public release: read applications and environments, open a copy of a project and change its code, preview it, publish it, read logs, and take a backup. OAuth 2.1 with dynamic client registration, plus a workflow skill for the model.

ar.subtitle: انشر وأدر تطبيقاتك
ar.description:
رقيم كلاود يشغّل تطبيقاتك من مستودع الكود. هذه الإضافة تصل المساعد بحسابك في رقيم كلاود، فيقرأ ما هو منشور، ويفتح نسخة من المشروع لتعديل الكود على آلة معزولة، ويعرض معاينة قبل النشر، ثم ينشر بعد موافقتك.

وتُجيب أيضًا عمّا تعطّل: نشر فشل، أو آلة لا تقلع، أو سجلات المحاولة الأخيرة، أو نسخة احتياطية تأخرت. كل تغيير يُنفَّذ في الخلفية ويعود بمفتاح مهمة يُتابع به، فلا تخمين ولا تكرار.
